canary-cdash-reporting.body:
# Canary CDash reporting

## First actions

```console
canary query -c ext.cdash.overview
canary query -c ext.cdash.xml_reporting
canary query -c ext.cdash.cdash_api
```

## What this extension does

The CDash extension can create CDash XML from Canary jobs, include measurements and compressed output, attach artifacts, and upload files to a CDash server.

## Typical environment

```console
export CDASH_URL=https://example/cdash
export CDASH_PROJECT=ProjectName
```

## Debugging tips

- Confirm that jobs have completed and have testcase.lock files.
- Confirm CDash URL and project variables are set.
- If XML validation is enabled, check schema validation errors first.
- For failed upload, inspect curl output when debug logging is enabled.
